editorial.blurb: A lively seafood boil spot in Chinatown where you tie on a bib, dig into spicy citrusy shrimp and mussels, and let the attentive staff handle the mess.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the shrimp & mussels combo with the everything sauce and waffle fries—it's generous enough for two—and arrive ready to get messy; the staff will cut open your boil bag tableside.
